In 1869 a Russian Scientist Dmitri Mendeleev brought a broad concept of a systematic classification and arrangement of elements. Mendeleev's periodic law states that "The physical and chemical properties of all are the periodic function of their atomic masses. i.e. all the elements are arranged in the order of increasing atomic mass and the table based on this law is known as Mendeleev's periodic table.
25. Arrange the elements Na, Li and K in the increasing order of first ionization energy.

The elements Na, Li, K are placed in the same group of periodic table. Li lies in 2nd period, Na lies in 3rd period and K lies in 4th period in periodic table. We know that when we move from top to bottom of group in periodic table then the value of ionization energy is decreased due to increasing the size of atom. The order of increasing ionization energy of the element is K < Na < Li
